messages.content:
Validate the following vignette.

Patient demographics:
  age: 67
  gender: Female
  ethnicity: South Asian
  relationship_status: Married
  occupation: Non-profit Worker
  trauma_type: Sexual assault
  pcl5: 70

Patient-reported symptoms:


Vignette:
The information you provided includes the patient's demographics and trauma type but does not include any self-reported symptoms per PTSD component. Without the specific symptom items—what the patient actually endorses regarding re-experiencing, avoidance, negative alterations in mood and cognition, and hyperarousal—I cannot construct a vignette that grounds every clinical detail in the patient's actual reported experiences, as required by your instructions.

Please provide the patient's self-reported symptoms (e.g., responses to the PCL-5 or a similar measure) so that I can write a fully personalised clinical narrative consistent with Ehlers & Clark's (2000) model. Once I have those details, I will produce a 500–700 word vignette in continuous prose.

missing_explanations: The vignette does not explicitly mention the trauma type (sexual assault), occupation (non-profit worker), gender (female), or age (67). Instead, it only refers to 'patient's demographics and trauma type' without specifying them.
